name: UK QA engineer seeking concrete accessibility policies

constraints: Self-stated need for an accessible workplace
context.company_awareness: Selective employer shortlist, expanded only when policy and role fit look credible

trigger: A promising technical role offers an inclusion statement but no clear way to discuss interview or workplace adjustments.

searches_run.query: QA automation engineer jobs UK remote hybrid
searches_run.observation: Submitted as the broad query in a two-query batch. The returned output was dominated by the policy query, so no specific QA vacancy or broad-query result ordering is claimed.

searches_run.query: software engineering interview reasonable adjustments accessibility employer UK careers
searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned government/charity guidance and employer process pages from FCA, VodafoneThree and DWP Digital. Direct FCA inspection gave named stages, contact routes and possible adjustments while explicitly retaining individual and role-specific conditions.

sources.title: Workplace adjustments for candidates — FCA
sources.supports: Direct inspection documents contact routes, possible accessible formats/locations and assessment adjustments, with role-specific conditions. It does not prove this persona's needs will be met or that a QA vacancy exists.

sources.title: Reasonable Adjustments — VodafoneThree Careers
sources.supports: Retrieved employer page discusses assessment accessibility and alternative formats; an example of a policy source, not verified implementation.

sources.title: How we recruit — DWP Digital
sources.supports: Retrieved employer process page explains where candidates can state adjustment needs; no individual outcome is inferred.

best_entry_page.primary_query: software engineering jobs accessible interview process UK
best_entry_page.promise: Show how to compare employer-published recruitment and workplace policies alongside QA role requirements, with contact routes and unanswered questions.
best_entry_page.cta: Compare the role and employer policy sources
proof_needed: Dated employer policy links separate from vacancy text
No accessibility certification inferred from inclusion language
Job Seek's own accessibility tested before targeting this audience
New indexable guide; current company/search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Does accessible mean anything specific for my stated needs?
Can I find a contact before entering a long application?
Does remote flexibility apply to this team?
Will your own search and tracker be accessible?
Are policies current, and do you distinguish a policy from an agreed arrangement?

avoid_targeting.reason: No employer accessibility guarantee or certification is demonstrated.
Suitability cannot be inferred from disability; use the applicant's stated requirements.
Legal advice is outside the product and this research.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I know the QA work I want to do and the arrangements I need. Help me find the employer's actual process and contact person, without guessing what I can do or treating an inclusion slogan as confirmation.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, two queries and one direct inspection. No disability type, capability limitation or accommodation preference beyond the assignment is inferred. No legal advice, employer implementation audit, volume or ranking claim. Broad-query evidence is limited by combined retrieval output; remaining queries are hypotheses.
